sloka: स मुहूर्तादुपश्रुत्य देवर्षिरमितप्रभः ।स्वमाश्रमं शिष्यवृतः क्षुधार्तः सन्न्यवर्तत ।। ७.८१.१ ॥
transliteration: sa muhūrtādupaśrutya devarṣiramitaprabhaḥ ।svamāśramaṁ śiṣyavṛtaḥ kṣudhārtaḥ sannyavartata ।। 7.81.1 ॥

translations.english: After a short while, the divine sage of immeasurable splendor, surrounded by his disciples and afflicted by hunger, returned to his hermitage, having heard (something amiss).
